gaps.contract-dependency: The exact 2.9.0 source and artifact are pinned, but installation, adjacent-version refusal, and upgrade evidence are not complete.
gaps.clean-target: No native source-to-target setup and target observation has been exercised.
gaps.dirty-target: Hostile shared-option siblings and target-owned settings preservation need native before-and-after evidence.
gaps.identity-references: Post-type selections, conditional taxonomy terms, template rules, and comment-type semantics remain outside this slice.
gaps.native-behavior: The five toggles have source-level consumers, but native settings authoring and frontend/API behavior are unproven.
gaps.derived-state: Page-cache purging, blocked-attempt counters, review state, and upgrade markers need separate derived-state evidence.
gaps.deletion: The plugin owns destructive core comment deletion, but no safe adapter deletion contract is declared.
gaps.failure-recovery: No native write failure, rollback, or retry evidence exists.
gaps.concurrency-idempotence: No concurrent settings save or complete target recapture fixed-point evidence exists.
gaps.lifecycle: Activation, deactivation, uninstall, and reinstall behavior have not been exercised through the capsule.
gaps.data-boundary: Network settings, counters, role lists, comment types, and plugin telemetry remain intentionally unclaimed.
gaps.scope-platform: Single-site scope is declared, but supported WordPress versions, plugin combinations, and native scope behavior remain unproven.
